invariants: Lineage uses one corpus listing and no inspections; missing targets and target-connected cycles retain literal typed diagnostics.
Complete lineage includes a detached root and closest-first ancestry; partial lineage omits root and reports the first unresolvedParentId.
Descendants are oldest-first with ASCII tie ids; explicit stacks construct at least 3500 descendants without Python recursion.
Whole-log surface folding classifies current/shadowed/log-only records and preserves direct positional replacement chains and cited source/derived event order.
Event target existence is checked before whole-log surface validation; invalid surface errors retain the original fold failure cause.
Raw windows validate before/after before source work, clamp to captured log bounds, and reuse one adopted target snapshot at its position in the returned window.
readSession/readSurface/readEvent detach snapshots and freeze identified message payloads while event envelopes remain caller owned; cold reads do not activate sessions.
Canonical JSONL replacement objects round-trip through durable JSON while existing append literals remain readable, including a fresh backend instance after publication.
identity: Exact signal/root error/cause, target-window snapshot alias, cloned headers and adopted message identities are preserved in enumerated scenarios.
ownership: One-shot queries retain no live lease or full cached history; corpus owns source selection and started inspections. Event outputs and lineage records are detached.
ordering: Ancestry is closest-first; descendants are sorted oldest-first; fold validation precedes event classification, after target lookup. Invalid windows precede source resolution.
errors: Fourteen lineage and thirty event observations freeze actual names, codes, messages, causes and raw results. Neither ordinary failures nor aborts are suppressed.
cancellation: Existing direct signals reach corpus; traceSession also accepts the historical internal options adapter. Enumerated pre-abort and persisted failures preserve reason identity.
adaptation: Explicit stacks replace recursive descendant construction. Canonical JSONL serialization uses the current persistence provider; legacy SQLite serialization controls remain native compatibility coverage. ASCII collation only is certified; message snapshots use canonical adoption.
open_questions: A new clean full gate and actual extracted Python 3.8.10 remain required. Controlled listing/inspection/failure seams are distinct from six actual canonical JSONL none/zstd consumer lanes. Complete FTS/filter/index generations, non-ASCII locale collation, arbitrary Task cancellation/provider epochs, Web/profile composition and deferred Win7 are unaccepted.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.

historical_native_compatibility_notes: Any retained legacy native SQLite unit controls are product compatibility tests, not evidence for a canonical rc.1 SQLite persistence provider. Current Source persistence comparisons mount canonical JSONL none/zstd.
